test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some balloons are flowers.

All flowers are colours.

All colours are rainbows.

**Conclusions:**

(I) All flowers are rainbows.

(II) Some balloons are colours.

options.text: Both conclusion (I) and conclusion (II) do not follow.

solution:
Given Statements:

Some balloons are flowers.

All flowers are colours.

All colours are rainbows.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e18a4edba1c5f300a4e4fd08451761476a0746aeea07fef0e46f2c86c4c901a8.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All flowers are rainbows - True (Because, All flowers are colours and All colours are rainbows, so All the flowers are part of rainbows).

II. Some balloons are colours - True (Because, Those part of balloons which is flowers will also colours).

So, Both conclusion (I) and conclusion (II) follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
